newsitem.title: USA: Maine plans conferences to grow small businesses.
newsitem.headline: Maine plans conferences to grow small businesses.

text.p: Maine Gov. Angus King plans to hold a series of regional conferences to help small businesses expand that will begin later this month in Presque Isle, said the coordinator on Wednesday.

King, who hired the Maine Development Foundation to coordinate the events, says the series will offer the state's 30,000 small businesses practical assistance, like putting them in touch with officials and others who can help them.
The series of conferences ends on November 25, when the last session will be held in Rockland, a coastal city.
The Maine Development Foundation is a nonprofit, economic development group.
